PRINTERS.py.summary: This class models the Printers screen for iOS Smart application. It uses declarative locators and method definitions for Page Object Model structure. Contains validations, navigation checks, and automation flows for printer setup, search, and connection. Implements robust exception handling and platform-specific logic for iOS and MAC. Follows enterprise test automation best practices.
